2609.24559.title: $t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context
2609.24559.paper_summary: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. On fev-bench they score 42.2 and 46.7 in skill, the latter third again and 2.0 points behind the leader. We analyze $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ in depth. Known-future covariates raise its skill by 6.3 percentage points across 30 tasks. The report also examines its calibration, its rollout strategy on long horizons, and its robustness to missing data. On the Victoria electricity-demand benchmark, $\texttt{t0-beta}$ is among the most accurate models with a context of nearly a year. In an independent Macrocosm evaluation of hourly ERCOT prices over 29 months, both cut the MAE of the lagged-price baseline by 38%.
2609.24559.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 $t_0$，一系列用於多變量背景預測的開放權重基礎模型。 我們釋出其前兩個成員：$\texttt{t0-alpha}$ 和 $\texttt{t0-beta}$，分別擁有 102M 和 256M 參數。 兩者都在不進行特定任務重新訓練的情況下，根據目標歷史、過去的協變量和已知的未來協變量來條件化其預測。 它們的Transformer層在時間和變量之間交替注意。 它們通過分位數預測產生概率預測。 預訓練結合了策劃的公共數據和構建的合成生成器家族，以包含協變量到目標的依賴關係。 在 GIFT-Eval 上，$\texttt{t0-alpha}$ 的總體 CRPS 達到 0.4941，而 $\texttt{t0-beta}$ 的 CRPS 為 0.4738 和 MASE 為 0.6865，兩者均排名第三，並且在最佳零-shot TSFM 之內的 4.0%。 在 fev-bench 上，它們的技能得分分別為 42.2 和 46.7，後者再次排名第三，落後於領導者 2.0 分。 我們對 $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ 進行了深入分析。 已知的未來協變量使其技能在 30 個任務中提高了 6.3 個百分點。 報告還檢查了其校準、長期的推廣策略以及對缺失數據的穩健性。 在維多利亞電力需求基準測試中，$\texttt{t0-beta}$ 是最準確的模型之一，背景接近一年。 在對 29 個月的每小時 ERCOT 價格進行的獨立 Macrocosm 評估中，兩者均將滯後價格基線的 MAE 削減了 38%。
